name: Cemindia Projects Ltd
title: Cemindia Projects Ltd - 509496 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹10,061 cr (+9%) and Q4 EBITDA margin 15.1% flattered by ₹150 cr one-time claims; management guides 10–10.5% margin and 20–25% FY27 growth.

capex.quote: It will be around INR350 crores to INR400 crores.

triggers.label: Q4 margin one-off: ₹100 cr claims
triggers.quote: this will not be a regular phenomenon. It will be around 10% to 10.5% going forward.

triggers.label: Order book ~₹29,000 cr; FY27 growth 25%
triggers.quote: Revenue should be at least 25% more than this year.

triggers.label: Data-centre division, ~₹3,000 cr from group
triggers.quote: So far, it is around INR3,000 crores we have secured from our group.

triggers.label: Dividend delayed, no FY26 payout
triggers.quote: dividend was supposed to be declared, but there is some delay in our process.

guidance.quote: Revenue should be at least 25% more than this year.
It will be around 10% to 10.5% going forward.
maybe INR25,000 crores is our target.
It will be around INR350 crores to INR400 crores.

red_flags.label: One-off claims inflate Q4 margin
red_flags.quote: the margin this quarter has come from a few provisions which we have kept for a few metro jobs, which we have to release

red_flags.label: Group-linked related-party mobilisation advances ₹1,400 cr
red_flags.quote: mobilization advance is the same as per the last year also, not much increase.

red_flags.label: Dividend not declared
red_flags.quote: there is some delay in our process. It is there. It will be declared very soon.

red_flags.label: Vadhvan project stalled, no clarity
red_flags.quote: we have got no idea why it is getting delayed.

evasions.quote: So unless we start and do the job, it is difficult to say what will be the margin.
we have got no idea why it is getting delayed.
exactly, I don't have a number how much it will be affected, but there will be some effect, of course, yes.
